svg.text: Single-extruder: 16 height levels. Adjacent pixels at different levels create height cliffs → high spatial variance.
Multi-head N=3: 16 levels collapse into M=⌈16/3⌉=6 phases. → low spatial variance
16 height levels · 5-colour palette (repeats) · N=3 heads · M=⌈16/3⌉=6 phases · ≤3 unique colours per layer level · Kromacut · spatial variance optimization
